title: VektorOS Review (2026)
intro: VektorOS is evaluated here as project management & productivity software — VektorOS is a business operations and work management platform for SMB teams — tasks, workflows, and client delivery tracking. Quote/tiered pricing (2026-08-19 — confirm on vektoros.com). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose VektorOS for lightweight service-business ops.
verdict: Choose VektorOS for lightweight service-business ops. Compare monday.com or Hive for broader PM depth. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is VektorOS a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. VektorOS is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is VektorOS priced?
faq.answer: Contact/trial — confirm published seat pricing on vendor site.

faq.question: Does VektorOS have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test VektorOS?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
